projects.name: Palisades Nuclear Plant
projects.buyer: Wolverine Power Cooperative and Hoosier Energy
projects.financing: DOE loan of up to $1.52 billion
projects.summary: Fuel loading began on Aug 30, 2026 and was halted when a fuel assembly tilted in the reactor. The NRC approved a one-time plan to recover it, and Holtec removed it on Oct 21, so fuel loading can resume. Holtec has not set a restart date. The NRC also found a chilled work environment in two Holtec departments, with no violations.

milestones.text: Shut down by Entergy
Sold to Holtec for decommissioning
Power purchase agreement with Wolverine Power Cooperative
DOE closed a loan of up to $1.52 billion
NRC approved the return to an operating licensing basis
Returned to operational status
New fuel delivered to the site
Fuel loading into the reactor began
Reconnected to its 345 kV switchyard
NRC approved a one-time plan to recover a tilted fuel assembly
Tilted fuel assembly recovered
Finish fuel loading, testing and startup
Contracted power sales begin

projects.name: Crane Clean Energy Center
projects.summary: Refurbishment is under way, and Constellation says the project is ahead of schedule for a 2027 restart. The NRC finished its environmental review on Sep 18, 2026, finding no significant impact, and has approved receipt of new fuel. It is still reviewing one exemption and three license amendments needed for power operation through Apr 19, 2034. PJM has warned that full grid upgrades may not be finished until after 2030.

milestones.text: Permanently shut down as Three Mile Island Unit 1
Restart announced with a 20-year Microsoft power agreement; renamed Crane Clean Energy Center
DOE closed a $1 billion loan
FERC approved moving 760 MW of grid interconnection rights from Eddystone
NRC issued a draft environmental assessment
NRC approved receipt of new fuel (Amendment 307)
NRC final environmental assessment: no significant impact
NRC decision on the exemption and three license amendments
Return to service (Constellation target)

projects.name: Duane Arnold Energy Center
projects.summary: NextEra is preparing to build new cooling towers (the originals were removed after the 2020 derecho) and to restore other site systems. The NRC issued a draft environmental assessment on Aug 4, 2026, finding no significant impact, and a restart panel is inspecting the work. NRC staff have said licensing decisions could come in January 2028. NextEra plans to restart no later than early 2029.

milestones.text: Shut down after a derecho damaged its cooling towers
NextEra asked the NRC to restore power operations
25-year power agreement with Google; NextEra takes full ownership
NRC issued a draft environmental assessment
DOE closed a $1.9 billion loan
NRC final environmental assessment
NRC licensing decisions (NRC staff estimate)
Return to service (NextEra target)
